# Food Recipe Collector (`alexbj75-food-recipe-collector-app`)

Effortlessly collect and organize all your favorite recipes with our powerful app. Paste any recipe URL, let our backend do the heavy lifting, and enjoy a unified, easy-to-navigate view. Delight in hassle-free culinary exploration today!

[Source](https://github.com/alexbj75/Food-Recipe-Collector-app)

## Example

```terraform
resource "osc_instance" "example" {
  service_id = "alexbj75-food-recipe-collector-app"
  name       = "myapp"

  parameters = {
    databaseUrl = "..."
    # allowOrigin = "true"
  }
}
```

Commented lines are optional parameters. Values marked `"..."` need a real value. Outputs are `url`, `external_ip`, `external_port` and the raw `instance` document, see the `osc_instance` resource.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `allowOrigin` | boolean | no | Controls Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) permissions for the API, determining which domains can make requests to the backend |
| `databaseUrl` | string | yes | Complete database connection URL containing all necessary connection parameters for the MariaDB instance where recipes are stored |

The instance `name` must match `^\w+$` and be unique per service within the workspace. OSC lowercases it and allows at most 20 characters.

Parameter values are strings; booleans take `"true"` or `"false"`. Reference an `osc_secret` as `osc_secret.<name>.ref` to keep a value out of the instance configuration. This page is generated from the OSC catalog; the provider validates against the live catalog when planning.
